# Elori

> Elori is a scrapbook collage maker for iPhone and iPad. Create photo and video collages, mood boards, photo dumps, and social media posts with templates, stickers, filters, frames, and text.

This website introduces the app, showcases its creative content, and provides help and policies. The links below point to the English pages.

## Explore

- [Home](https://tryelori.com/): App overview and features.
- [Gallery](https://tryelori.com/gallery/): Browse collage templates and creative content available in Elori.
- [FAQ](https://tryelori.com/faq/): Help with editing, exports, subscriptions, purchases, privacy, and support.
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/elori-scrapbook-collage-maker/id6759309696): Download Elori for iPhone and iPad.

## Optional

- [Privacy policy](https://tryelori.com/privacy-policy/): Information about data collection and use.
- [Terms of use](https://tryelori.com/terms-of-use/): Terms for using Elori.
- [Sitemap](https://tryelori.com/sitemap.xml): Index of site pages, including individual gallery entries and localized pages.
